purpose: Confirm whether asset-local price direction and volatility path, optionally augmented by asset-neutral cross-sectional breadth, identify MA breakout events that continue across the complete Binance USDT perpetual universe. Compare fixed rules with two deliberately small pooled models without using symbol or asset class as a feature.

data.market: all Binance USDT-margined perpetual contracts present in the historical Vision archive or contemporaneous exchangeInfo; no crypto-only, US-stock-only, or hand-selected trading universe filter
data.timeframe: complete UTC 1d bars aggregated from audited 15m bars
data.confirmation_period: 2026-07-01 through the last event having a complete horizon before 2026-08-25
data.daily_sequence: per-symbol consecutive observed complete daily sessions; a gap greater than four calendar days starts a new block
data.gap_policy_reason: supports both 24/7 contracts and contracts with regular weekend or holiday closures; gap diagnostics remain mandatory

events.entry: next observed complete daily session open
events.exit: open after 10 or 20 complete held sessions

local_features.atr20: simple mean true range over 20 observed complete sessions
local_features.atr_path_percentile_60: causal percentile of atr_change_10d_pre over the trailing 60 observations including the current pre-breakout measurement
local_features.atr_down_count_10_pre: number of negative ATR20 changes in the ten observations ending t-1
local_features.atr_up_count_10_pre: number of positive ATR20 changes in the ten observations ending t-1
local_features.breakout_range_ratio: true range on t divided by ATR20[t-1]
local_features.er20: absolute 20-session net close move divided by the 20-session absolute close path
local_features.rv20: annualized standard deviation of 20 log returns using sqrt(365)
local_features.return_5_10_20: close return over 5, 10, and 20 observed sessions
local_features.volume_ratio_5_20: mean quote volume over five observations divided by mean quote volume over twenty observations

asset_neutral_breadth.trend_balance: fraction up_state minus fraction down_state among eligible contemporaneous symbols
asset_neutral_breadth.atr_expansion_share: fraction of eligible contemporaneous symbols with atr_change_10d_pre > 0

fixed_rules.P2_LOCAL_FIXED: SLOPE_ALIGNED and breakout_range_ratio > 1.20 and (long atr_path_percentile_60 > 0.80 or short atr_path_percentile_60 <= 0.20)

machine_learning.label: one if direction-signed next-open-to-exit-open return exceeds the frozen round-trip fee and slippage cost, otherwise zero
machine_learning.selection: score above the training-sample 80th percentile; threshold is never chosen from test profitability

validation.training: expanding history; only rows whose exit date is strictly before the test window are eligible
primary_comparisons: confirmation versus historical walk-forward direction and magnitude
diagnostic_slices_only: known US-stock-like Binance contracts versus all other contracts

costs_and_account.funding: not available for this P3 price-only confirmation and therefore excluded; promotion is blocked until actual funding is added
costs_and_account.entry_ordering: descending fixed-rule diagnostic score or model score with symbol as deterministic tie-break

event_statistics: two-way symbol and date clustered t-stat and 95 percent confidence interval

decision_boundary.fixed_or_ml_filter_pass_requires: positive post-cost mean in the locked confirmation period, same sign in a majority of historical walk-forward folds, adequate sample count, and no single direction or asset slice accounting for the entire result
decision_boundary.failure_action: report NO-GO or INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE; do not rescue with threshold, feature, holding-period, or leverage tuning
